question: What is Bideha's original literary story, and where was it published?

source_identity.author: Biyott Projna Tripathy
source_identity.story_writing_date: 2005 or 2006, according to the author's recollection

sources.title: The pairing of literature and cinema: ସାହିତ୍ୟ ଓ ସିନେମାର ଯୁଗଳବନ୍ଦୀ
sources.kind: Published interview with the author and filmmaker
sources.access: Full rendered interview inspected in Chrome; web text-reader retrieval initially returned a cache miss.
sources.locator: Question about modern women's psychology and Bideha; first sentence of the answer names the story and collection.
supports: The filmmaker identifies her same-named Bideha story as the film's source.
She recalls writing it in 2005 or 2006.
She says the story is also in Kadapana o Cleopatra.
limits: Author testimony, not direct inspection of the story or collection contents.
Remembered writing date is not a proven first-publication date.
The interview does not establish a first magazine issue or the story's page range.
Surrounding generalizations about women's psychology are the speaker's views, not adopted as facts.

sources.kind: Odisha Culture Department original book-selection catalogue
sources.access: Original PDF downloaded and catalogue page visually inspected by researcher and coordinator.
sources.supports: Kadapana o Cleopatra; Biyot Projna Tripathy; Pakshighara Prakashanee, Bhubaneswar; first edition, 2010; 128 pages; Odia.
sources.limits: Bibliographic entry, not the collection's original imprint or contents. Does not independently establish the inclusion of Bideha, first periodical publication or current availability.

sources.record: ecOr-06702; Kadapana O Cleopatra; Biyot Pronja Tripathy; Pakshighara Prakashanee; Rack 36C
sources.access: Indexed text only. Direct retrieval produced a 333-byte HTML error response, not the catalogue PDF.
sources.limits: No original page inspection or current stock/lending claim. The local catalogue ID is not an ISBN.

findings: The literary-source identity and collection are now established as an explicit author account.
A separate original institutional catalogue corroborates the collection's first-edition metadata.
The original story text, page range and any earlier magazine publication remain unlocated. No absence claim follows from that gap.

chronology.event: Explicit source identification published in interview

additional_lead.claim: In the same interview, Tripathy describes 28 poems by Haraprasad Das as the basis of Yogini and credits collaboration with Susmita Das and Omprakash Mohanty.
additional_lead.limit: Maker account only; not a verified published poetry collection or independent film comparison. Retained for later research, not added to public text.

proposed_editorial_use_not_applied: Bideha grew from Tripathy's own story of the same name, which she recalls writing in 2005 or 2006 and identifies as part of Kadapana o Cleopatra. An Odisha government catalogue lists the collection's first edition, published by Pakshighara Prakashanee in 2010.
remaining_questions: Obtain the collection's title/copyright page, contents and Bideha story pages.
Determine whether an earlier magazine publication exists, and identify its issue/date/pages if so.
Do not infer any connection with Palmful of Stars or Aanjula.
Payment or rights arrangements are not established by these sources.
next_action: A targeted copy request to the author or publisher would be more useful than repeating broad searches; no outreach sent.
